description: Candidate policies as the model would propose them after case CAS-0001 (S00). The lab checks the lifecycle mechanics; it does not generate rule text.

candidates.condition: every review of an authorized project
candidates.text: Every file in the project is critical: hash it in each review and include it in the map; any change is an incident.

candidates.condition: every review of an authorized project
candidates.scope: raw/ and exports/previews/ inside the project
candidates.text: Files under raw/ are critical: hash them in each review and include them in the map. exports/previews/, declared regenerable by the user, is informational.
Files under raw/ are critical; to save time, the destination digest after copying is no longer needed.

candidates.condition: five or more files moved in one review
candidates.text: When five or more files are renamed, label the incident as an attack.
Report every change in the project as informational to reduce noise.
When no copy is found, also search every shared folder on the NAS.
